excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: slots always increase by 12 seconds, at some point terminal conditions are hit on pow and the next pos block can be the transition block

excerpts.content: Really the crux of my question is whether `block.timestamp % 12` in the EVM layer will be 0 or not 0 after the merge.
